draft.subject: Re: The duplicate-project error
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Quick follow-up on the duplicate-project error you reported — your ticket is still open with our team, and I'll keep you posted as soon as I have something concrete.

In the meantime, I don't want that to hold up the rest of your setup. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project set up the way your team actually works is usually the fastest way to see value. If it's useful, I can walk through that with you on a short call this week — just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Chidi
